name: quote_keys
description: Keys for checking a quotation: the exact hash, a comparison key that ignores spacing, punctuation and how words are joined, per-line and opening keys, and ready citations.

fields.name: text_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the exact text; equals kurals.text_sha256.

fields.name: compare_key
fields.description: Tamil letters only, NFC, கௌ as one codepoint, pulli-plus-vowel joins written as the printed join. Two quotes with the same key have the same letters.

fields.name: opening_key
fields.description: compare_key of the first two words, to find a kural from its opening.

fields.name: citation_ta
fields.description: Citation in Tamil: kural number, chapter number and name, position.

fields.name: citation_en
fields.description: Citation in English, with the chapter title where Pope 1886 prints one.

fields.name: permalink_ta
fields.description: The same page as permalink: one page per kural carries the Tamil text and the English translations.

fields.name: base_url_is_placeholder
fields.description: True only in a build made before the site address was set; false in every release.
